title: 初雪
summary: The excitement of the winter’s first snowfall.
paragraphs: 今朝、まどの外を見て、びっくりしました。雪がふっていました。今年の初雪です。
町が白くなって、とてもきれいでした。子どもたちは外で雪だるまを作っていました。
私も外に出て、少しあそびました。手はつめたかったですが、楽しかったです。
paragraphsEn: This morning I looked out the window and was amazed. It was snowing — this year's first snow.
The town turned white and looked beautiful. Children were building a snowman outside.
I went out and played a little too. My hands were freezing, but it was fun.
